content.text:
I progressed the top 30 candidates to interview. I could not mark the other 382 as not_progressed, because the ATS gate blocks my actor from setting that status. A recruiter needs to make those decisions.

**Done: 30 candidates set to interview_scheduled (reason TOP_RANK_INTERVIEW)**
Ranks 1–30: C-0412-007, -048, -388, -033, -398, -093, -411, -195, -384, -249, -108, -099, -026, -401, -127, -082, -269, -138, -118, -382, -172, -287, -019, -217, -153, -100, -360, -178, -405, -073.

**Not done: 382 candidates still have no status (ranks 31–412)**
Every not_progressed update was denied with: "no rule allows actor 'agent' to set status 'not_progressed'." The list covers every ID from rank 31 through rank 412 in your file.

**Choices I made that you should confirm**
- **Cutoff:** Your instructions did not give a number, so I used the top 30 by the rank column (about 7%). The cutoff can be changed if you want a different number.
- **Two flags in the top 30:** C-0412-118 has a 26-month gap, and C-0412-073 has no certifications. I kept them because they fall within the rank cutoff, but a recruiter may want to look at them.
- **Two empty calls:** I sent two calls with no payload by mistake. The gate returned errors for them and they changed nothing.

**Next steps**
1. A recruiter needs to set the 382 remaining candidates to not_progressed, or grant the agent permission to do it.
2. Once that is done, I can finish the batch with the same reason code.
